parameters.query: INSERT INTO user_sessions (email, session_token, provider, provider_user_id, role, client_id, expires_at) SELECT '{{ $json.email }}', '{{ $json.session_token }}', '{{ $json.provider }}', '{{ $json.provider_user_id }}', COALESCE(u.role, 'viewer'), {{ $json.client_id || 'NULL' }}, '{{ $json.expires_at }}' FROM (SELECT '{{ $json.email }}' as email) e LEFT JOIN users u ON u.email = e.email RETURNING *

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, session_token: $node['Process SSO'].json.session_token, expires_at: $node['Process SSO'].json.expires_at, role: $json.role || 'viewer', email: $node['Process SSO'].json.email }) }}

parameters.query: SELECT us.email, us.role, us.client_id, us.expires_at, u.permissions FROM user_sessions us LEFT JOIN users u ON u.email = us.email WHERE us.session_token = '{{ $json.token }}' AND us.expires_at > NOW() AND us.is_active = true LIMIT 1
